from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
class C(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(); self.stack=[]; self.bad=[]
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag in {'br','img','input','meta','link','hr','source','area','base','col','embed','param','track','wbr'}: return
        self.stack.append(tag)
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag in {'br','img','input','meta','link','hr','source','area','base','col','embed','param','track','wbr'}: return
        if not self.stack or self.stack[-1]!=tag:
            self.bad.append((tag, list(self.stack[-5:])))
            return
        self.stack.pop()
p=Path('relocation_jobs/static/index.html')
c=C(); c.feed(p.read_text())
print('unclosed', c.stack[-10:] if c.stack else 'ok')
print('mismatches', c.bad[:5] if c.bad else 'ok')
